summary: Backend-only regression re-test (iteration 4) of BUB Makekal Hulu palm oil app via the public URL. Both iteration_3 criticals are CONFIRMED FIXED. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 19 to 28 pytest tests (added: PUT /trips/{unknown} -> 404 + no orphan, PUT /trips/{lid} in-place update with orphan detection, DELETE 404 for purchases/trips/expenses, dashboard stats via httpOnly cookie only, app-level CORS credentials check, regex-safety of farmer_name). Result: 27/28 passed (96%), stable across 3 consecutive runs (parallel + serial). The single failure is a genuine, reproducible 500: an unescaped farmer_name interpolated into a Mongo $regex.

critical.issue: farmer_name is interpolated raw into a Mongo $regex ({'$regex': f'^{farmer_name}$'}) at server.py:357 and :468. A name containing regex metacharacters (verified with 'TEST_Pak (Budi') raises pymongo OperationFailure 'Regular expression is invalid: missing closing parenthesis' -> HTTP 500 Internal Server Error and the purchase is NOT saved. Real users typing '(', '[', '*', '+' or '?' in a farmer name will silently lose data. Fix: re.escape(farmer_name) before building the regex.

minor.issue: Still unauthenticated (only /auth/me, /dashboard/stats and PATCH /trips/{id}/pay require JWT). POST /api/seed-demo is especially dangerous: it delete_many()s purchase_transactions, sales_trips and operational_expenses with no auth. Previously reported in iteration_3, not fixed.

Playbook item 5 not implemented: the admin is only inserted when absent. If ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env changes, the existing admin's password_hash is never updated, so the documented credential silently drifts from the DB. Add an else-branch that re-hashes and updates password_hash when it no longer verifies.
Uses PurchaseTransactionCreate, so partial updates are not supported and omitted optional fields (photo_url, notes) are reset to defaults. Previously reported, not fixed.

Per-item exceptions are swallowed and only logged; synced_counts still counts them, so an offline client marks failed records as synced. Return a per-item failures array. Previously reported, not fixed.

action_items: CRITICAL: re.escape() farmer_name before the Mongo $regex lookup in server.py:357 and server.py:468 (currently HTTP 500 + data loss for names with regex metacharacters).
Protect write endpoints with JWT, at minimum POST /api/seed-demo which wipes all transactional collections.
Make seed_admin idempotent-with-update: re-hash and update password_hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified fixed: PUT /trips/{trip_id} now looks up by local_id (and ObjectId fallback), 404s when absent, and binds payload.local_id = trip_id before delegating to create_sales_trip -> no more orphan inserts.
Verified fixed: GET /dashboard/stats now has Depends(get_current_user); returns 401 unauthenticated and 200 with Bearer token or httpOnly cookie.
Verified fixed: DELETE /purchases|/trips|/expenses/{id} now raise 404 when deleted_count == 0.
server.py is 1060 lines - split into routers/ (auth, purchases, trips, expenses, dashboard) + services/stock_pool.py.
compute_virtual_stock_pool() pulls up to 10k purchases + 5k trips into memory on every stock-pool/trip/sync/dashboard call; migrate to an aggregation pipeline.

PUT /trips re-uses create_sales_trip as an upsert; acceptable now, but the 'update' path replaces the whole document, so any field not in SalesTripCreate (e.g. payment flags set by PATCH /trips/{id}/pay) is silently reset on edit - worth verifying against the paid-trip flow.

Additionally deleted 5 auto-created TEST_ farmer records left behind by the purchase auto-farmer-registration (farmers collection back to the 8 real/demo records). Playbook checks: (1) password_hash starts with $2b$ PASS; (2) httpOnly cookie set on login PASS (public response also gets Secure/SameSite=None/Partitioned added by the edge); (3) CORS allow_credentials=True with explicit origin list PASS at app level (localhost:8001 echoes the exact origin) - the preview edge proxy rewrites allow-origin to '*' and sometimes drops allow-credentials on OPTIONS, which is infra behaviour, not an app bug; (4) brute-force lockout intentionally REMOVED per user request - 7 consecutive wrong passwords all 401, no 429, correct password still works PASS; (5) seed_admin does NOT update an existing admin when the password changes - FAIL, see minor issues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest suite: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (28 tests) runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, self-cleans via the session 'created' fixture. It is xdist-safe now: trip-orphan assertions match on payload fingerprint instead of total trip count (total-count assertions were flaky under -n auto because other tests create trips concurrently). Passing: auth (no lockout, bcrypt, cookie), stock-pool schema, backdated purchase/trip/expense, DUAL commodity trip math (total_revenue 3,391,000; unloading_cost 56,900 default / 72,600 custom), PUT purchase recompute, 404s on PUT/DELETE unknown ids for all three resources, PUT trip in-place update with and without local_id in body, WAC + grade_b_returned revert after trip delete, sync idempotency, dashboard 401/200 (Bearer + cookie). Only TestRegexSafety::test_purchase_with_regex_special_char_farmer_name fails - re-run it after the re.escape() fix. Frontend was not tested in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Remaining failure RCA: server.py:468 in create_purchase does `existing_farmer = await db.farmers.find_one({'name': {'$regex': f'^{farmer_name}$', '$options': 'i'}})` (same pattern at :357 in create_farmer). MongoDB compiles the interpolated string as a PCRE, so any unbalanced metacharacter raises OperationFailure code 51091 ('Regular expression is invalid'), which is not caught and surfaces as a 500 before the purchase document is inserted -> user-visible save failure and data loss. Reproduction: POST /api/purchases with farmer_name='Pak (Budi'. Mitigation: wrap with re.escape(farmer_name) (and optionally add a unique case-insensitive collation index on farmers.name instead of a regex lookup).
